subject: Gov-Cloud onshore handoff & compliance checkpoint (NordicTech / APAC)
messages:
From: Sarah Holst <sarah.holst@nordictech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:17:00Z
Subject: Gov-cloud onshore handoff for HK pilot (MOU attached)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The Ministry of Health in HK has asked NordicTech to provide an onshore deployment path for the upcoming patient-data-transformation pilot. They specifically require:

- Data residency within HK jurisdiction (no token egress)
- Customer KMS or HSM integration for key custody
- SOC2 + policy evidence and audit logs for token access
- A minimal latency SLA for the inference path (<= 200ms p50 target)

We attached an initial MOU to scope roles. Can Redwood confirm whether you can:

1) Support KMS integrations (Cloud or HSM) and provide recommended configuration
2) Deploy a VPC/on-prem connector for the customer (we expect private peering)
3) Sign a 3-month pilot SOW with a limited retainer and an option to move to Dedicated capacity afterwards

Proposed POC window: week of Jan 24. Can you run an internal ops/legal check this week and let us know blockers?

Best,
Sarah
Head of Partnerships, NordicTech
[attachment: MOU_NordicTech_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Holst <sarah.holst@nordictech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Gov-cloud onshore handoff for HK pilot (MOU attached)

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear ask and the MOU. High-level answers up front: yes we can support a KMS-backed deployment and we have a VPC/on-prem connector pattern that preserves KV cache locally (no upstream token leakage). A few clarifying questions so we scope the right path:

- Which key management systems are acceptable to the Ministry (Cloud KMS, customer HSM vendors)?
- Does the Ministry require a fully air-gapped on-prem install or is a VPC-private-peering model acceptable?
- Is the 200ms p50 measured from the customer gateway, or from the Redwood edge within region? That changes routing.

I'll spin up a quick ops-runbook draft and propose an internal kickoff tomorrow morning (Jan 11) to align Product/Partners/Legal. If that works I will invite Priyom (finance/procurement) and Vanessa (solutions) to cover retainer/SOW constructs.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
